top_signals.title: BlackRock Flags ‘Generational High Yields’ in Corporate Credit
top_signals.summary: BlackRock Inc. says current corporate bond yields offer a more resilient source of returns that doesn’t depend on expectations for falling interest rates or tighter spreads.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Nickel Rallies Past $16,00 on Prospect of Indonesia Output Cuts
top_signals.summary: Nickel rose for a fourth day as the prospect of coordinated output cuts by Chinese producers in Indonesia raised expectations of tighter supply.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
